question: Two approved policy bundles both appear to apply at the same moment. Can I use whichever passage looks most similar to my case and finish the ready packet?
reviewer_rationale: SOP-07#missing-policy is required because an ambiguous required bundle is shipment-global and similarity cannot establish policy authority; exact active policy/version/section support is required. This is bundle-selection ambiguity, not a harmless supplemental-search miss or a missing section limited to one category.
